image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a printed restaurant menu on textured paper. The menu features a list of food items with descriptions and prices on the right side, and three small illustrative images of dishes (pancakes, a green salad/dish, and a bread roll) on the left. In the background, there is another folded card or menu stand with similar illustrations and text, along with blurred elements suggesting a table setting (possibly a cup or container). The lighting is warm and somewhat dim, casting soft shadows.
